macros.name: alwaysDeduce
macros.doc: The \alwaysDeduce command is used to (re)set the deduce style to a default and is executed every time a deduction is typeset.

macros.name: branchDeduce
macros.doc: \branchDeduce produces centered branching (Takeuti/Gentzen-style) dots, \ddotsDeduce left-to-right diagonal dots, and \dotsdDeduce right-to-left diagonal dots.

macros.name: dotsdDeduce
macros.doc: \branchDeduce produces centered branching (Takeuti/Gentzen-style) dots, \ddotsDeduce left-to-right diagonal dots, and \dotsdDeduce right-to-left diagonal dots.

macros.name: LeftLineLabel
macros.doc: \LeftLineLabel and \RightLineLabel commands which work like \LeftLabel and \RightLabel but place a label next to the conclusion of an inference/deduction instead of the score line.

macros.name: LeftSubproofLabel
macros.doc: \LeftSubproofLabel and \RightSubproofLabel commands which work like \LeftLabel and \RightLabel but place a label next to the entire preceding subproof with a curly brace.

macros.name: RightLineLabel
macros.doc: \LeftLineLabel and \RightLineLabel commands which work like \LeftLabel and \RightLabel but place a label next to the conclusion of an inference/deduction instead of the score line.

macros.name: RightSubproofLabel
macros.doc: \LeftSubproofLabel and \RightSubproofLabel commands which work like \LeftLabel and \RightLabel but place a label next to the entire preceding subproof with a curly brace.

macros.name: shortDeduce
macros.doc: \straightDeduce produces a simple vertical line of dots, and \shortDeduce a line of half that length.

macros.name: straightDeduce
macros.doc: \straightDeduce produces a simple vertical line of dots, and \shortDeduce a line of half that length.
